page_title: TOT 3-1 BOU | Tottenham Hotspur v Bournemouth 31/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+12' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bournemouth players look gutted.
90+11' Wait! Referee Simon Hooper immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+9' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
90+9' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+8' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
90+3' Ange Postecoglou (Tottenham) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+3' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Simon Hooper lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+2' The game is interrupted now, Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+2' A cross into the box from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
87' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
87' OFF THE WOODWORK! Bryan Gil (Tottenham) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
84' 3 - 1 Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
83' Substitution. Giovani Lo Celso makes his way off the pitch and Eric Dier (Tottenham) comes on as his replacement.
82' Substitution. Brennan Johnson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
82' Here is a change. Richarlison is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Alejo Veliz (Tottenham).
82' Substitution. Adam Smith (Bournemouth) makes way for David Brooks.
80' 3 - 0 Goal! Richarlison (Tottenham) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Brennan Johnson, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
79' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
78' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece.
77' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' The game is interrupted now, Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

74' Richarlison (Tottenham) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Neto, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
71' 2 - 0 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) scores an easy goal. He receives a precise pass inside the box and sends the ball past the goalkeeper, glancing in off the right post.
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ryan Christie walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
67' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
64' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Philip Billing (Bournemouth) coming on for Justin Kluivert.
61' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Luis Sinisterra will be replaced by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
60' Close! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
58' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
58' Referee Simon Hooper signals NO PENALTY for Tottenham after a VAR review!
58' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Tottenham! Let's see what he decides.
58' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
56' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
54' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
54' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
52' Heung-Min Son plays a lovely pass into Richarlison (Tottenham), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
52' The corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.

51' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
51' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner.

50' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
46' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Maximillian Aarons comes on the pitch for Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+9' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+8' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
45+8' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
45+6' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

45+6' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
45+5' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+4' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar! It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
45+3' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post.
42' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
40' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and Simon Hooper interrupts the game. Bournemouth have a free kick from a promising distance.
39' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

36' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Guglielmo Vicario makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
35' A dangerous towering header by Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
35' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
34' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
32' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pape Matar Sarr limps off the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
30' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' A cross from the by-line finds Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
28' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but Guglielmo Vicario punches the ball away.
28' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
27' Bournemouth quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
27' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
26' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Neto.
25' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

24' What an opportunity! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
24' A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth. Simon Hooper blows his whistle after Pedro Porro (Tottenham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
20' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
19' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.
19' Richarlison (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
19' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

18' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Neto! The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
15' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
13' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
13' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
12' The ball is cleared after Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
9' 1 - 0 GOAL! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.

7' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a comfortable save!
4' Richarlison (Tottenham) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
2' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Simon Hooper was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
